# Animation recipes (format version 1)

<!-- Generated by tests/recipe/check.php from includes/recipe.php and shared-constants.json. Do not edit by hand: run `wp eval-file tests/recipe/check.php schema`. -->

A recipe is one block's Motion Blocks animation as JSON. AI agents and other tools read and write recipes through the `motion-blocks/*` WordPress abilities (see the main README), and the same format is used for the saved library. The machine-readable definition is [`animation-recipe.v1.json`](animation-recipe.v1.json) (JSON Schema); this page is the same information for people.

```json
{
    "version": 1,
    "mode": "scroll-appear",
    "entry": {
        "type": "slide",
        "direction": "btt",
        "duration": 0.6,
        "easing": "ease-out"
    }
}
```

`null` instead of a recipe means "no animation".

## Top-level fields

| Field | Values | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | Recipe format version. **Required.** |
| `mode` | `page-load`, `scroll-appear`, `scroll-interactive` | page-load: plays once the page loads. scroll-appear: plays as the block scrolls into (entry) and out of (exit) view. scroll-interactive: progress follows the scroll position. **Required.** |
| `effect` | object | Page Load / Scroll Interactive: the effect. |
| `entry` | object or null | Scroll Appear: what plays as the block enters the view (null for none). |
| `exit` | object or null | Scroll Appear: what plays as the block leaves the view upwards (null for none). |
| `repeat` | `once`, `loop`, `alternate` | Page Load only. Default once. |
| `pauseOffscreen` | boolean | Page Load loops only: pause while off screen. Default true. |
| `range` | object | Scroll Interactive only: where in the block's pass through the view the animation runs, e.g. "entry 0%" to "exit 100%" (the default). |
| `target` | `block`, `image` | "image" animates only a Cover block's background image. Default block. |
| `stagger` | object or null | Cascade the block's direct children one after another (Group, Columns, Buttons, Gallery, List; not Scroll Interactive). |

## Effect fields

Inside `effect`, `entry` and `exit`. Only `type` is required.

| Field | Values | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | see Effects | Effect. What each one looks like, its directions and options: the `catalog` from get-effects, or schema/README.md. "custom" uses `from` / `to`; "image-move" and "image-zoom" only work on a Cover with an image background. |
| `direction` | see Effects | Where the motion comes from: btt (bottom to top), ttb, ltr, rtl; horizontal / vertical for curtain. Optional; each effect has a sensible default. |
| `duration` | number, 0.05 to 60 | Seconds. Default 0.6. |
| `delay` | number, 0 to 60 | Seconds before it starts. Default 0. |
| `easing` | string | ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, spring, bouncy, snappy, or any CSS cubic-bezier() / steps() / linear() function. Default ease. |
| `blur` | integer, 0 to 200 | Blur effects only: blur in whole px. Default 8. |
| `rotate` | integer, -3600 to 3600 | Rotate effects only: angle in whole degrees. Default 90. |
| `from` | object | Custom effect values. Numbers get the default unit (px for translate and blur, deg for rotations); strings may carry their own (24px, 50%, 2rem, 45deg, 0.5turn). clipPath takes inset(), circle(), ellipse(), polygon(), rect(), xywh() or path(). |
| `to` | object | Custom effect values. Numbers get the default unit (px for translate and blur, deg for rotations); strings may carry their own (24px, 50%, 2rem, 45deg, 0.5turn). clipPath takes inset(), circle(), ellipse(), polygon(), rect(), xywh() or path(). |
| `replay` | `once`, `repeat`, `reverse` | Scroll Appear only. In `entry`: once (default): plays the first time only. repeat: every time it enters. reverse: plays backwards as it leaves at the bottom. In `exit`: reverse (default): plays backwards when scrolled back. repeat: every time. once: only the first time. |

## Effects

Where an effect can be used: `page-load` / `scroll-interactive` (in `effect`), `entry`, `exit`.

### `fade`: Fade In (in an Exit: Fade Out)

Fades from transparent to fully visible. In an Exit it fades away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`

### `fade-out`: Fade Out

Fades from visible to transparent.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`

### `slide`: Slide In (in an Exit: Slide Out)

Fades in while moving 50px into place from one side. In an Exit it fades out moving 50px towards that side.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `btt` (Bottom to top), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left). Default `btt`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `slide-out`: Slide Out

Fades out while moving 50px away in the chosen direction.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Directions: `btt` (Bottom to top), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left). Default `ttb`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `wipe`: Wipe

Reveals the block with a straight edge sweeping across it (a clip-path wipe), without fading. In an Exit it wipes the block away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `btt` (Bottom to top). Default `ltr`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `curtain`: Curtain Open (in an Exit: Curtain Close)

Reveals the block from the centre outwards, like curtains opening. In an Exit it closes from the edges inwards.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `horizontal` (Horizontal), `vertical` (Vertical). Default `horizontal`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `curtain-out`: Curtain Close

Hides the block from the edges inwards, like curtains closing.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Directions: `horizontal` (Horizontal), `vertical` (Vertical). Default `horizontal`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `flip`: Flip (in an Exit: Flip Out)

Fades in while turning 90 degrees into place in 3D, like a card flipping over. In an Exit it flips away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `btt` (Bottom to top). Default `rtl`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `scale`: Scale In (in an Exit: Scale Out)

Fades in while growing from 75% to full size. A direction adds a 50px drift from that side; "none" scales in place. In an Exit it shrinks away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `btt` (Bottom to top), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left), `none` (None). Default `none`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `scale-out`: Scale Out

Fades out while shrinking to 75%, optionally drifting 50px in the chosen direction.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Directions: `btt` (Bottom to top), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left), `none` (None). Default `none`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`

### `blur`: Blur In (in an Exit: Blur Out)

Fades in while going from blurred to sharp. Set the starting blur with `blur` (px, default 8). In an Exit it blurs away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `blur`

### `blur-out`: Blur Out

Fades out while blurring (`blur` sets the amount in px, default 8).

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `blur`

### `rotate`: Rotate In (in an Exit: Rotate Out)

Fades in while turning into place from an angle. Set the angle with `rotate` (degrees, default 90; negative turns the other way). In an Exit it turns away.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `rotate`

### `rotate-out`: Rotate Out

Fades out while turning by `rotate` degrees (default 90).

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `rotate`

### `image-move`: Image Move (Beta)

Cover blocks with an image background only. Pans the background image (enlarged to 120%) across the frame in the chosen direction while the text stays still. Best with Scroll Interactive, for a parallax feel.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Directions: `btt` (Bottom to top), `ttb` (Top to bottom), `ltr` (Left to right), `rtl` (Right to left). Default `btt`.
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `direction`
- Cover blocks with an image background only.

### `image-zoom`: Image Zoom (Beta)

Cover blocks with an image background only. Slowly zooms the background image from 100% to 120% while the text stays still.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`
- Cover blocks with an image background only.

### `custom`: Custom

Your own start and end values, in `from` and `to`: opacity, translateX, translateY, scale, rotate, rotateX, rotateY, blur and clipPath. Anything left out stays at the block's normal look.

- Use in: `page-load`, `scroll-interactive`, `entry`, `exit`
- Options: `duration`, `delay`, `easing`, `from`, `to`

## Easings

Named: `ease`, `linear`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`, `spring`, `bouncy`, `snappy`. Or any CSS `cubic-bezier()`, `steps()` or `linear()` function, e.g. `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.

## Custom `from` / `to` properties

| Property | A bare number means | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `opacity` | a plain number | `0` |
| `translateX` | px | `-40 or "10%"` |
| `translateY` | px | `24 or "2rem"` |
| `scale` | a plain number | `0.9` |
| `rotate` | deg | `-8 or "0.25turn"` |
| `rotateX` | deg | `45` |
| `rotateY` | deg | `90` |
| `blur` | px | `6` |
| `clipPath` | a CSS shape: inset(), circle(), ellipse(), polygon(), rect(), xywh() or path() | `"inset(0 50% 0 50%)"` |

## More examples

```json
{
    "version": 1,
    "mode": "page-load",
    "effect": {
        "type": "custom",
        "duration": 0.8,
        "easing": "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
        "from": {
            "opacity": 0,
            "translateY": 24
        },
        "to": {
            "opacity": 1,
            "translateY": 0
        }
    }
}
```

```json
{
    "version": 1,
    "mode": "scroll-appear",
    "entry": {
        "type": "fade",
        "duration": 0.5
    },
    "stagger": {
        "step": 0.1
    }
}
```
